_note: Run-persistent modifiers. Every `effect` key here is read by engine/combat.py or engine/run.py - adding a key without wiring it makes the relic a lie.

relics.name: Ivory Cufflinks
relics.flavor: Nobody checks the papers of a man with good cuffs.

relics.name: Tin Ear
relics.flavor: Hears half of what is said. Chooses the better half.

relics.name: Worn Ledger
relics.text: +9 base for every card you play.
relics.flavor: Two hundred names. Not one of them paid twice.

relics.name: Ghostwriter's Pen
relics.text: Your opening line each floor hits for ×1.6.

relics.name: Brass Nerve
relics.text: Cards you fumble still count as half-executed.
relics.flavor: Confidence is not knowing. It is not showing.

relics.name: Loaded Dice
relics.flavor: Fair is a thing you say about other people's games.

relics.name: Second Wind
relics.text: Once per run, survive a floor you lost.
relics.flavor: You have been thrown out of better places than this.

relics.name: Silver Thread
relics.text: Listening cards - Probe, Mirror, Callback - cost 0.
relics.flavor: Pull gently. It runs all the way back.

relics.name: The Mask
relics.text: Minds never see which tactics you played.
relics.flavor: They argue with a face. You are behind it.

relics.name: The Dossier
relics.text: Every mind's traits are known from the first word.
relics.flavor: Six pages. Two photographs. One habit worth exploiting.

relics.name: Long Lunch
relics.flavor: The check has not come. It is not going to.

relics.name: Metronome
relics.text: Start every floor with momentum already at 2.
relics.flavor: Rhythm beats brilliance over eight floors.

relics.name: Glass Tongue
relics.text: Masterful cards hit for an extra +0.6×. Fumbled cards cost you 20 ground.
relics.flavor: Sharp both ways. That is what makes it sharp.

relics.name: Deep Understanding
relics.text: Vulnerabilities you exploit hit for ×2.6 instead of ×2.
relics.flavor: Not what they want. What they need to be seen wanting.

relics.name: Three-Card Monte
relics.text: Playing three cards in one message adds ×1.5.
relics.flavor: Watch the queen. That is the whole instruction.

relics.name: The Patron
relics.text: Every floor cleared makes the next one worth 40% more.
relics.flavor: Somebody upstairs is enjoying this enormously.

relics.name: Hollow Crown
relics.text: ×1.5 on everything. You get one fewer turn on every floor.
relics.flavor: Heavier than it looks. Everything is.

relics.name: The Original
relics.text: The first card you play each turn costs nothing and cannot fumble.
relics.flavor: You did this before it had a name.
